report.title: Golden-journey confirmation against the packaged artifact with a deterministic postcondition
report.question: Does the built deliverable actually work, as opposed to its source tree being green? Drive three to five golden journeys against the PACKAGED artifact and end each in a deterministic postcondition probe on the file it produced - existence, minimum size, and a format or content assertion. Question: does any journey pass on the source tree but fail on the package?
report.answer: No: every golden journey that passed its file-level postcondition on the source tree also passed against the extracted wheel, and the packaged sys.path did not include the unpackaged source tree.

exit_code_only_detail.reason: produced-file assertion is mandatory; exit-code-only is rejected

procedure: Build a py3-none-any wheel from probes/CNF-0039/src using stdlib zipfile (pip is absent).
Extract the wheel into probes/CNF-0039/_install, outside the import path of src/.
Run four journeys via python -P -s with PYTHONPATH=_install and cwd a scratch dir.
End each journey in a file postcondition: exists, min_bytes, JSON/markdown content.
Repeat the four journeys against the unpackaged src/ tree for the source-vs-package question.
Corrupt one produced file to a one-byte fragment and require the postcondition to FAIL.
Reject any journey whose only postcondition would be process exit code 0.
